quotes.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
I'm not afraid of storms, for I'm learning how to sail my ship.
I am no bird; and no net ensnares me: I am a free human being with an independent will, which I now exert to leave you.
It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach.
quotes.note: Να ζω πιο συνειδητά, κάθε μέρα

quotes.text: I did not wish to live what was not life, living is so dear; nor did I wish to practise resignation, unless it was quite necessary.

page.text: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived. I did not wish to live what was not life, living is so dear; nor did I wish to practise resignation, unless it was quite necessary.
